messages:
sophia_support: FYI — Cust-987 says their embeddings index started failing after they pinned the model. Expected vectors of length 1536, now receiving 1024. Ingestion throws shape mismatch.

kevin_cust_success: when did they pin and to which identifier?

sophia_support: they pinned to `redwood-embed-large@2026-03-01` around 2026-03-04. They only noticed when nightly batch ingestion started failing.

raj_eng_ml: can you paste the exact API request (redact keys) and one sample response?

sophia_support: here's the curl they used (redacted):
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large@2026-03-01","input":"hello world"}'\n```
And response (trimmed):
```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "embedding",
      "embedding": [0.001, -0.002, ...],
      "vector_length": 1024
    }
  ],
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 3}
}
```
They also provided our SDK error from their indexer: `ValueError: expected embedding shape (1536,), got (1024,)`.

ops_bot: auto-detect: Routing note — request matched alias `redwood-embed-large` -> resolved variant `redwood-embed-large-compat-1024` due to capacity fallback at 2026-03-04T02:14:22Z. Request id: req_j4k2-zz.

raj_eng_ml: ah — looks like a fallback/alias mapping routed them to a compat variant with reduced dimensionality. We added the compat-1024 variant during an optimization rollout to handle lower memory hosts, but the alias resolution logic should not swap variants for pinned identifiers.

kevin_cust_success: customer pinned to the alias expecting stable dims. They're pretty upset since their nightly pipeline broke. Any quick mitigation we can give them?

raj_eng_ml: short-term: ask them to set the explicit variant suffix that guarantees 1536, e.g. `redwood-embed-large@2026-02-10-stable` or use the explicit model id `redwood-embed-large-1536` (we have that canonical id). I'll confirm the exact stable id.

sophia_support: I told them to try `model: redwood-embed-large-1536` and they're testing now. Also asked them to hold ingestion for the next hour.

raj_eng_ml: long-term: this is a bug in alias fallback prioritization when `@` pins are present. I will open a patch to prevent alias->compat substitution when a user supplies a pinned timestamped alias. Creating GH PR and INC ticket.

deploy-bot: Created incident INC-4321: "alias fallback swapped pinned embed variant -> dims changed (1536 -> 1024)". Assigned to @raj_eng_ml.

kevin_cust_success: can we offer the customer a short-term credit or assist with reindexing? They lost ~40k docs ingestion.

raj_eng_ml: once we confirm the rollback path, ops team can run a migration to re-embed the failed documents if they'd like. I will also add a hotfix to alias resolver today; aim to deploy to prod canaries in 3 hours.

sophia_support: customer confirmed `redwood-embed-large-1536` returned 1536-dim vectors. They're unblocked for now if we guide them to use that explicit id. They've asked us to notify when root cause fixed so they can unpin.

raj_eng_ml: action items:
- open PR to change alias resolution (in progress)
- rollback any alias remap that created `redwood-embed-large-compat-1024` as the default for alias resolution (ops)
- postmortem + customer note (support)

kevin_cust_success: I've offered them a reindex run and a billing credit while we fix. Cust accepted.

sophia_support: marking this thread resolved for first-contact. Keeping INC-4321 open until alias resolver patch is deployed and we confirm no other customers effected. Will follow up here when patch lands. :white_check_mark:

raj_eng_ml: thanks — I'll post the PR link and deploy timeline in INC-4321. :thumbsup:

sophia_support: closing loop with customer now. "Thanks for the quick heads up, we're pushing a fix and for now please use the explicit `-1536` id."

Notes for ops: check logs around 2026-03-04T02:10-02:20Z for mass fallback events; possible capacity autoscale churn triggered alias remap.
